text: Find the value of x that satisfies x + 7 = 15.
hints: When a positive number crosses the equals sign (=), its sign changes to negative (subtract).
feedback: Be careful! When +7 moves to the right side, it changes from addition to subtraction (15 - 7). Check your subtraction again.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

text: The value of y that satisfies y - 9 = 4 is...
hints: Isolate variable y on the left side.
Move -9 to the right side. Subtraction becomes addition.
feedback: Watch the operation sign. Because the left side subtracts 9 (-9), moving it to the right side means adding 9 (4 + 9).
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Because 5 is smaller than 12, the result is negative.
feedback: Remember: a = 5 - 12. Since the subtracted number (12) is greater than the number being reduced (5), the result must be negative.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Move -15 to the right side as +15.
feedback: Move -15 to the right side as +15, so the equation becomes m = -8 + 15. This is equivalent to 15 - 8.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Because 18 is positive, it becomes subtraction on the right side.
feedback: Do not be misled by the position of 18. Because 18 is positive, it becomes subtraction on the right side (30 - 18).
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

feedback: To eliminate -6.5 on the left side, add 6.5 on the right side (3.5 + 6.5). Recheck the decimal addition carefully.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

feedback: Rewrite the equation as k = 3 - (1/2). Subtracting one half from 3 leaves 2.5 or 5/2.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

text: The value of n that satisfies -7 + n = 14 is...
hints: Move -7 from the left side to the right side.
The negative sign on -7 becomes positive +7 on the right side.
feedback: The number -7 is negative on the left side. When moved to the right side, its sign becomes positive (14 + 7).
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Move -14 to the right side as +14.
Think of owing 20 and paying back 14; the remaining debt is the result.
feedback: The equation becomes x = -20 + 14. It is like owing 20 and paying back 14, so the remaining debt is 6 (value -6).
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Subtract 25 from 11; the result is negative.
feedback: Move +25 to the right side to get 11 - 25. Because 25 > 11, the final result is negative.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: 4x means 4 multiplied by x. The inverse of multiplication is division.
Move 4 to the right side as the divisor.
feedback: The form 4x means 4 multiplied by x. To find x, divide 28 by 4, not subtract it.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: A positive number divided by a negative number gives a negative result.
feedback: Remember the division sign rule! A positive number (21) divided by a negative number (-3) always gives a negative result.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

text: The value of a that satisfies a/5 = 6 is...
hints: a/5 means a divided by 5. The inverse of division is multiplication.
Move 5 to the right side as a multiplier.
feedback: The number 5 is the divisor (denominator). Moving it to the right side changes the operation to multiplication (6×5).
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Move the divisor -4 to the right side by multiplying.
Multiplying two negative numbers gives a positive result.
feedback: Pay attention to the multiplication signs of negative and positive numbers. Multiplying -9 by 4 gives a negative result.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Multiply both sides by the denominator (3), or multiply 12 by the reciprocal (3/2).
feedback: To isolate x, multiply 12 by the reciprocal of 2/3, which is 3/2. The result is 12×3÷2.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Move -8 to the right side as the divisor.
A negative number divided by a negative number gives a positive result.
feedback: Dividing two negative numbers (-56 ÷ -8) gives a positive result. Check your signs again.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: The inverse of dividing by 0.5 is multiplying by 0.5.
Multiplying by 0.5 is the same as dividing by 2.
feedback: Multiply 14 by 0.5. Multiplying by 0.5 is equivalent to dividing the number by 2.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Move 0.4 to the right side as the divisor.
Remove the decimals by multiplying numerator and denominator by 10: k = 16/4.
feedback: To make 1.6÷0.4 easier, remove the decimals by multiplying both numbers by 10, giving 16÷4.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

text: The value of n that satisfies (3/4)n = 15 is...
hints: Multiply both sides by -4 to remove the denominator.
feedback: Be careful with the negative sign. The equation leads to n=15×-(4/3), so the result is negative.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Move 15 to the right side as the divisor.
Calculate 75÷15 and keep the negative sign.
feedback: Dividing -75 by 15 gives a negative number. Check the 15-times table again.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Move the constant term (+5) to the right side first.
Divide both sides by 2 to find x.
feedback: Perform addition/subtraction first (17-5=12), then divide (12÷2).
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Move -8 to the right side as +8.
feedback: Move -8 first to make +8 (13+8=21). Then divide 21 by 3.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Move +12 to the right side as -12.
feedback: Move +12 to the right side to get -3-12=-15. Then divide -15 by 5.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Divide both sides by 4 first to remove the parentheses.
Move -2 to the right side: m = 4+2.
feedback: You can divide 16 by 4 first to get m-2=4, then add 2 to the right side.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Remove the denominator 3 by moving it to the right side as multiplication.
feedback: Do not subtract 4 before moving the denominator 3. Multiply 5 by 3 first (15), then subtract 4.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

text: The value of p from -2p + 9 = 25 is...
hints: Move +9 to the right side as -9.
feedback: First simplify to -2p = 25-9 = 16. Then divide 16 by -2 (watch the negative sign).
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Move the constant 7 to the right side.
feedback: Remember that the negative sign belongs to 3k, making -3k. Then -3k = -11-7 = -18. Divide -18 by -3.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Move -3 to the right side first, giving (2y/5)=10.
Get 2y by multiplying 10 by the denominator 5 (2y=50).
feedback: Step 1: add 3 to the right side (7+3=10). Step 2: multiply by 5 (50). Step 3: divide by 2.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Distribute 3 into the parentheses, or divide both sides by 3.
If you divide by 3, you get 2n+1=9.
feedback: If distributed: 6n+3=27 → 6n=24. If divided by 3 first: 2n+1=9 → 2n=8. Check your calculation.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Combine the constants on the left: 4-2x=2 → -2x=2-4.
feedback: Be careful when expanding -2(x+3)! It becomes -2x-6, not +6. So 10-2x-6=2 → 4-2x=2.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Collect the variable terms x on the left and constants on the right.
feedback: Group variable terms on one side (5x-2x=3x) and constants on the other (9+3=12).
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

text: The value of y that satisfies 7y + 4 = 3y - 12 is...
hints: Move 3y to the left side and +4 to the right side.
feedback: Moving 3y to the left makes -3y, giving 4y. Also move +4 to the right as -4 (-12-4=-16).
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Collect constants on the left and variables on the right, or vice versa.
feedback: If 4a moves right, 6a-4a=2a. Move -2 left as 10+2=12. The result is 2a=12.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Use the distributive property to expand both parentheses.
feedback: Expand both sides first: left = 3m+6, right = 2m+14. Then combine like terms.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Move -2p to the right side so the variable coefficient is positive.
feedback: Collect the variable terms: -2p-4p=-6p and the constants: 20-8=12. Dividing -6p=12 gives a negative value.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Move 2k to the left and -5 to the right.
feedback: Subtract 2k from 6k to get 4k, and add 15+5 to get 20. Then calculate 20÷4.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Collect the fractional terms on the left: (1/2)x-(1/4)x=5-3.
feedback: Subtract the fractions: (1/2)x-(1/4)x=(1/4)x. The constants give 5-3=2. Therefore (1/4)x=2.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

text: The value of n from 5(n - 1) = 3(n + 3) is...
feedback: Expanding the parentheses gives 5n-5=3n+9. Move like terms to get 5n-3n=9+5 → 2n=14.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Be careful with the minus before the parentheses. Expand to 9x-2x-5=3x+11.
feedback: A minus before parentheses changes every sign inside: -(2x+5) becomes -2x-5. Combine to get 7x-5=3x+11.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

hints: Expand the multiplication in the parentheses: 8z-4=6z+10.
Collect variable terms on the left: 8z-6z=10+4.
feedback: Expand to 8z-4=6z+10. Then move like terms: 8z-6z=10+4 → 2z=14.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

text: (Parang Batik - Java) A craftsperson produces Parang-pattern batik cloth. The price of 3 pieces after a voucher discount of Rp20,000.00 is Rp250,000.00. What was the original price of 1 piece?
hints: Model it: let the price of 1 batik piece be x. Then 3 batik pieces minus the Rp20,000 discount equals Rp250,000.
Move 20,000 to the right side: 3x=270,000 → x=270,000/3.
feedback: The mathematical model is 3x-20,000=250,000. Add the Rp20,000 discount back to the total (270,000), then divide by 3.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

text: (Borobudur Temple - Central Java) A miniature Borobudur Temple uses layers of miniature relief stones. The lower layer has 15 more stones than the upper layer. If both layers contain 85 stones in total, how many stones are in the upper layer?
hints: Let the upper layer contain x stones, so the lower layer contains x+15. The total is 85.
feedback: The model is x+x+15=85 → 2x+15=85. Subtract 15 from 85 (70), then divide by 2.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

text: (Angklung - West Java) Mr. Mamat sells small and large angklungs. A large angklung costs Rp15,000.00 more than a small one. If a buyer pays Rp105,000.00 for 2 small angklungs and 1 large angklung, what is the price of 1 small angklung?
hints: Let the small angklung price be x, so the large one is x+15,000.
Build the model for 2 small + 1 large: 2x+x+15,000=105,000.
feedback: Combine the prices: 2 small angklungs (2x) plus 1 large angklung (x+15,000) gives 3x+15,000=105,000. Subtract 15,000 before dividing by 3.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

text: (Rumah Gadang - West Sumatra) The length of a rectangular wall carving is $(2x + 3)$ cm and its width is $x$ cm. If its perimeter is 54 cm, what is x?
feedback: The rectangle perimeter is 2p+l. Substitute p and l: 22x+3+x=54 → 23x+3=54 → 3x+3=27.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

text: (Traditional Lupis Cake - Java) A mother buys 5 packages of lupis cakes and pays Rp50,000.00. She receives Rp15,000.00 in change. What is the price of 1 package?
hints: Money paid minus total cake cost equals the change. Let 1 package cost x.
feedback: Total spending equals money paid minus change: 50,000-15,000=35,000. Divide 35,000 by 5.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

text: (Traditional Keris - Nusantara) A collector measures a Luk 3 keris and a Luk 5 keris. The Luk 5 keris is 8 cm longer than the Luk 3 keris. If their total length side by side is 72 cm, how long is the Luk 3 keris?
hints: Let the Luk 3 keris length be x, so Luk 5 is x+8.
feedback: The model is Luk 3 + Luk 5 = 72 → x+x+8=72 → 2x+8=72.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

text: (Traditional Congklak) In a congklak game, Budi has 3 times as many seeds as Ani. If Budi gives 10 seeds to Ani, they then have the same number of seeds. How many congklak seeds did Ani have at the start?
hints: Let Ani have x seeds and Budi have 3x. If Budi gives Ani 10, Budi loses 10 and Ani gains 10.
feedback: After Budi gives 10 seeds, Budi has 3x-10 and Ani has x+10. The equation is 3x-10=x+10 → 2x=20.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

text: (Ulos Cloth - North Sumatra) Two Ulos cloths (standard and premium) are sold for a total of Rp450,000.00. The premium Ulos costs Rp90,000.00 more than the standard one. What is the price of the standard Ulos?
hints: Let the standard Ulos cost x, so the premium one costs x+90,000.
Subtract 90,000 from 450,000, then divide the result by 2.
feedback: The mathematical model is x+x+90,000=450,000 → 2x+90,000=450,000. Subtract 90,000 from 450,000, then divide by 2.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

text: (Tari Piring - West Sumatra) In a Tari Piring performance, the number of spare plates is 1/4 of the number of main plates held by the dancers. If there are 25 plates in total, how many main plates are used?
hints: Let the number of main plates be x, so spare plates are (1/4)x.
feedback: Add the fractions: x+(1/4)x=(5/4)x. The equation becomes (5/4)x=25. Multiply 25 by 4, then divide by 5.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx

text: (Sekaten Ceremony - Yogyakarta) In the Sekaten gunungan display, red wajik cakes are 20 fewer than twice the number of white wajik cakes. If there are 80 red wajik cakes, how many white wajik cakes are there?
hints: Let the number of white wajik cakes be x. Red wajik cakes = 2x-20.
The number of red wajik cakes is 80, so 2x-20=80.
feedback: The mathematical model is 2x-20=80. Move -20 to the right as +20 (2x=100), then divide by 2.
source: SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx / HINT SOAL SOLVOX.docx / FEEDBACK SOAL SOAL SOLVOX.docx
